intro: Krazek of Booty Bay says that learning about Nazz is quite a favor. While Krazek contacts sources, you are asked to bring 10 specks of dream dust, taken from dragon whelps in the Swamp of Sorrows, for Krazek's snuff pouch. Bring it back and Krazek will give you the information you seek.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Getting the information on Nazz is quite a favor, friend. Yes, quite a favor. But you've come all the way from the Shimmering Flats to get it... Are you willing to travel some more?
While I contact my sources, why don't you gather something for me, eh?
Hm... What will it be? How about dream dust, from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows. Yes, I'd love some dream dust for my snuff pouch!
Get it for me, friend, and I'll give you the information you seek.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Back so soon? Do you have my dream dust?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, look at that. You found the dream dust!
And how did you like the swamp, friend? It's not easy to get a hot meal there, is it?
